objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact in the P&R Management system that contains content, metadata, and undergoes creation, editing, review, release, and archival workflows

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document type describing specific procedures, process sequences, details and responsible persons

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A document type describing specific procedures within a framework and process sequence

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document supplement not subject to the release cycle of the main document, released directly via switches in properties

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document supplement automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A planned amendment to an existing document created without affecting content or version history

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to check whether a document remains valid after expiration of its validity period

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that has no additional validity

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated document

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with documents in the system through various roles and authorizations

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user role assigned write and read permissions on a document and responsible for creating and signing the document

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A user with personal change rights on a document but no relevance in the release workflow

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user role responsible for checking document content according to technical and formal aspects

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user role responsible for approving a document and deciding on its distribution to readers

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user role permitted to translate released content into another language

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user authorized to view approved documents assigned through User Groups

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned together for authorization and distribution purposes

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of User Groups and persons assigned to receive authorization and notifications for a document

objs.name: version
objs.description: A tracked instance of a document at a specific state in its lifecycle

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process for document approval consisting of creation, review, and release steps

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants to document the approval process

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: A record documenting all changes and approvals to a document for traceability

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined structure for a document type that can be selected when creating new documents

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific properties maintained for a document

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: The converted format of a document automatically generated after content is saved

objs.name: archive
objs.description: A storage state for invalidated documents with revoked authorizations except for the archive group

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initiate a new document in the system by attaching an information object and selecting a document type

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the content of a document using the editing client and Office components

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Set or update standardized and customer-specific properties and attributes of a document

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Grant read and write permissions to users and user groups for a document

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiate the workflow-supported approval process by submitting a document for review

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check document content according to technical and formal aspects as a reviewer

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and publish a document as a releaser, making it visible to assigned readers

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Apply an electronic signature during the workflow process to document approval

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make a released document visible to readers after completion of the release workflow

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new version of a released document with retained data from the previous version

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment as archived during document revision if no longer relevant

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Propose an amendment to an existing document without affecting the version history

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a new document version incorporating an approved change proposal

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm the continued validity of a document by updating its valid-until date

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiate a request to invalidate a document that has no additional validity

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare a document out of force and archive it, revoking all authorizations except for archive group

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiate a request to re-validate a previously invalidated document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restore an invalidated document to valid status creating a new version

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Notify assigned users and user groups via email when a new document version is released

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Require assigned users and user groups to actively confirm receipt and understanding of a document

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Actively verify receipt and understanding of a document as a recipient

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-dependent version of a released document

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check and approve a translated document version

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Publish a translated document making it visible to authorized readers in the corresponding language

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF format for web display
